treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the State of Qatar and the Government of the Republic of Yemen for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion (2000)
eif_quote: GTA AR feed: اليمن signature 7-أغسطس-2000, date 1-يناير-2008 || [QA MLI] Yemen Original 07/08/2000 01/01/2008
source_title: Qatar GTA: Arabic text of QA-YE Agreement (DTA Yemen (AR).pdf)

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; YE not an MLI signatory)

notes: Dividends: Art. 10(1) is poorly drafted ('may be taxed ... dividends paid by a company resident in one State to a resident of the other State only'); read as residence-only taxation (exclusive), consistent with Art. 11 — interpretation uncertain. Interest: residence-only (Art. 11(1)). ROYALTIES omitted: Art. 12(1) allocates royalties to the SOURCE State ('للضريبة في الدولة التي تنشأ فيها تلك الإتاوات') with no rate limit, so source taxation is uncapped by the treaty. Art. 27(3): the agreement is effective from 1 January of the year following the exchange of notifications; GTA lists 1 January 2008 as the date. Arabic only. Not MLI-covered.
